user_need: Understand what OpenHCS is, whether it fits an imaging workflow, and where to begin.

authority.role: Declares the published README, Python range, package dependencies, optional extras, console commands, and project links.
Declares the eight extracted package checkouts composed by the source repository.
Declares the CPU-safe desktop package extras selected by the graphical installers.
Owns the validated Python pipeline document shared by visual, code, and agent authoring.
Owns compile-time resolution across selected axes, compile progress emission, and construction of the execution bundle.
Declares ResolvedPipelineDefinition and CompilationSession named in the compilation diagram.
Declares set_progress_queue, which compilation requires before it emits progress events.
Declares the auto-registered DatasetSource family that the ImageXpress, Opera Phenix, Bio-Formats, OMERO and OpenHCS-format sources join.
Owns declaration-based callable discovery, execution memory contracts, processing contracts, and registry caching.
Owns manual and orchestrated image and ROI streaming through registered viewer declarations.
Declares the MCP capability profiles, including the full profile and governed custom-function registration.
Declares supported local MCP client targets such as ChatGPT desktop/Codex and Claude Desktop.
Declares import_cellprofiler_pipeline and its returned FunctionStep list and PipelineConfig.
Exercises all 30 declared CellProfiler comparison cases over ZMQ and validates live Napari and Fiji projections.
Declares the openhcs-benchmark subcommands and options, including run-measured through the OpenHCS session.
Declares the expert benchmark MCP tool names, including the session-backed measured-run finalizer.
Owns typed run provenance, lifecycle status, exact rerun arguments, and receipt validation.
Owns read-only inspection of receipts, observation progress, and structured artifacts.
Proves the installed command derivation, typed receipts, MCP projection, path policy, and inspect-only import boundary.
Declares the image, object-label, measurement, relationship, table, spatial and metadata artifact kinds used by materialization.
